plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for user authentication and identity. Acts as the user's principal credential.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure hash of the user's password, stored for login verification. Never exposed as raw credentials. Supports salt+hash with strong KDF (e.g., bcrypt with at least 10k rounds).

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether user email has successfully completed verification. Ensures user joins the platform with confirmed identity.

plainFields.name: role_status
plainFields.description: Logical user role state: 'user', 'pending', 'locked', or other application-defined value reflecting current account status for access and privilege control. Used for status gating, not for role escalation (see moderators/admins).

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the user's last successful login event. For security monitoring and anomaly detection.

plainFields.name: last_login_ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which last login occurred. Used for compliance and identity verification.

plainFields.name: permissions
plainFields.description: Comma-separated or JSON-encoded permission keys granted to this user. Used to determine the user's scope of action in the system.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: User account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time for this user record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When account was soft-deleted or deactivated (logical delete), if ever.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_moderators
models.description: Moderator roles assigned to elevated users responsible for community governance, content moderation, and escalation. Tracks moderator promotion/demotion, custom scope, role initiator, and temporal fields. Provides connection to the corresponding user entity (user id) and links to trace role assignment history. All moderator-specific access/permissions are referenced here, not in user table. Role-change events reference audit and escalation logs for full traceability.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced user account's {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}. Identifies user entity elevated to moderator status.

plainFields.name: promotion_reason
plainFields.description: Free-form text or policy code describing why promotion to moderator was enacted. Supports audit and compliance explanations.

plainFields.name: promoted_by_admin_id
plainFields.description: References the account ID (from admins) that performed this moderator assignment. May enable 1:N if multiple admins can assign moderators, else optional.

plainFields.name: moderator_scopes
plainFields.description: JSON or comma list of board/category codes specifying the scope (areas) the moderator can operate on. Limits access by domain. Used for fine-grained role isolation.

plainFields.name: demotion_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of demotion (or null if active). Allows historic tracking of role status transitions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when moderator record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update to this moderator record (role changes, scope changes, etc).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete (logical deletion) of this moderator role record.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_admins
models.description: Highest-level platform administrator roles. Each record links to a user that has been escalated to admin authority (direct system/policy/resource control). Tracks details of escalation (promotion origin), privileges (policy override, emergency grant), and historical status. Role assignment/demotion and temporary escalation events are traceable through this table, referencing user identities and admin action audit logs. Not directly linked to general user status (which remains in users table).

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Associated user account's {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}, representing this admin identity. Strict 1:1 correspondence between user accounts and admins.

plainFields.name: promotion_reason
plainFields.description: Text or code specifying why the user was promoted to admin. Maintains policy compliance and escalation rationale.

plainFields.name: promoted_by_admin_id
plainFields.description: Admin user (self or other) who executed the promotion. Used for cross-reference or audit chain building.

plainFields.name: demotion_at
plainFields.description: When this admin status was revoked (null if currently active).

plainFields.name: emergency_escalation
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether this admin promotion resulted from an emergency override/escalation (bypassing normal workflow). Tracks special escalation cases.

plainFields.name: policy_override_scope
plainFields.description: Comma-separated codes or JSON for areas/resources where this admin is permitted to override default policies. Enables flexible, granular authority modelling.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for the admin privilege record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Update timestamp for this admin role assignment record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete or logical removal timestamp for this admin role assignment record.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_posts
models.description:
Main entity for user-created discussion posts in the politico-eco-bbs service. Each record represents a user-generated thread with title, body, category, author, status, and moderation lifecycles. Supports referencing categories, creators (users), moderation actors, and rich content attachments (via attachment table). Historical edits, workflow changes, or moderation events are logged separately. All post data adheres to 3NF, with no pre-calculated aggregates or denormalized user information.

Key relationships:
- Category: Each post references a category (e.g., politics, economics).
- Author: Created by a registered user (politico_eco_bbs_users).
- Status/Workflow: Moderation and deletion handled by separate admin/moderator tables.
- Attachments: Linked via politico_eco_bbs_attachments.
- Comments: Comments stored separately for scalability.
- Supports unique (per-channel) title/indexes to enhance anti-duplication and search optimizations.

foreignFields.name: category_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the category of the post. {@link politico_eco_bbs_categories.id}

foreignFields.name: author_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user who created the post. {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}

foreignFields.name: last_editor_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user who last edited the post (nullable, for posts never edited). {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the post. Required, 1 to 100 characters, must pass prohibited word check.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Main content of the post, up to 10,000 characters. Rich text/Markdown permitted, must pass all filters.

plainFields.name: is_blind
plainFields.description: Whether the post is currently blinded (hidden from regular users by moderation action).

plainFields.name: is_locked
plainFields.description: Whether the post is locked (further comments or edits prevented).

plainFields.name: comment_count
plainFields.description: Current number of visible comments associated with this post (for query optimization, not persisted, can be recalculated).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when post was created. Set once upon creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update. Updated only when post is modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp (null if active).

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_post_drafts
models.description:
Stores draft states for posts being composed by users. Each draft is linked to its owner, allows limited number of concurrent drafts per user, and may reference an existing post for edit operations. Drafts are not visible to other users until published. Soft-delete and timestamped for audit.

Key relationships:
- Owner: Each draft is owned by a user (politico_eco_bbs_users).
- Target Post: Optionally references the post being edited, otherwise null for new drafts.

foreignFields.name: owner_id
foreignFields.description: User who owns the draft. {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}

foreignFields.name: target_post_id
foreignFields.description: If editing an existing post, references the original post. {@link politico_eco_bbs_posts.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Draft post title. May be null when user has not entered a title yet.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Draft post content. May be null in incomplete stage.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Draft creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification to the draft.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Draft soft-delete timestamp.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_comments
models.description:
Represents comments, and optionally replies, on posts. Each comment references its parent post and the author, and may have a parent comment (for reply/quote structure). Soft-deletion, blinding, and workflow status fields are included. Follows strict normalization: no user, post, or category data denormalized. All relations via foreign keys only; historical versions kept via snapshot model if introduced in future.

Key relationships:
- Post: Each comment is attached to a post.
- Author: Registered user.
- Parent: Optionally references another comment for threading (single-level nesting by business policy).

Moderation:
- Blind flag for moderatorial hiding.
- Deletion via deleted_at; all changes timestamped for audit.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Parent post this comment belongs to. {@link politico_eco_bbs_posts.id}

foreignFields.name: author_id
foreignFields.description: User who wrote the comment. {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}

foreignFields.name: parent_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Direct parent comment (for replies). Null for top-level comments. {@link politico_eco_bbs_comments.id}

foreignFields.name: last_editor_id
foreignFields.description: User who last edited this comment. Null if never edited. {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Text/body of the comment. Required, 1–500 characters, filter enforced.

plainFields.name: is_blind
plainFields.description: Whether this comment is currently hidden/blinded by a moderator.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time this comment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Time of most recent change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp (null if active).

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_comment_drafts
models.description:
Draft storage for comment creation or edit workflows. Each draft is associated with an owner (user) and a target post and/or comment. Used in client multi-step authoring or in in-progress edits; never visible to public until submitted. Implements audit fields for tracking saves, updates, soft-deletion. Each user may possess only a limited number of drafts per post by business policy.

Key relationships:
- Owner: Registered user.
- Post: Required parent post being commented on.
- Target comment: Optional, for replies or edits.

foreignFields.name: owner_id
foreignFields.description: User who owns the draft. {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: The post being commented under. {@link politico_eco_bbs_posts.id}

foreignFields.name: target_comment_id
foreignFields.description: If editing/replying, references the original comment. {@link politico_eco_bbs_comments.id}

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: The draft comment content. May be null until first save.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Draft creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Time this draft was last changed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp of draft (null if active).

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_attachments
models.description:
Attachment records for files (e.g., images, documents) assigned to a post or comment. Each record maintains metadata for security, moderation, and reference. Stores URI and references settings which define allowed extensions, sizes, and holds soft-deletion and blinding flags for moderation.

Key relationships:
- Attached to either a post or comment, one or both foreign fields enforced at application logic.
- References specific attachment settings for file type and policy enforcement.
- Creator: User who attached the file.
- Blinding: Marks attachments as visually hidden/pending review.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: If attached to a post, references the target post. {@link politico_eco_bbs_posts.id}

foreignFields.name: comment_id
foreignFields.description: If attached to a comment, references the target comment. {@link politico_eco_bbs_comments.id}

foreignFields.name: creator_id
foreignFields.description: User who uploaded this attachment. {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}

foreignFields.name: attachment_setting_id
foreignFields.description: Attachment settings reference for allowed extensions, size, etc. {@link politico_eco_bbs_attachment_settings.id}

plainFields.name: uri
plainFields.description: Permanent URI for retrieving the file resource. String must match policy and point to protected storage.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Original (user-uploaded) filename, extension enforced by settings.

plainFields.name: size
plainFields.description: File size in bytes, limited by attachment settings policy.

plainFields.name: is_blind
plainFields.description: Flag if this attachment is currently hidden by moderation action.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Attachment creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Attachment soft-delete timestamp (null if active).

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_likes
models.description:
Records of 'like' reactions from users on posts or comments. Each record links a user, target (post or comment), and is unique per user-content pair. Used for upvote/positive feedback features, prevents duplicate reactions via composite unique constraint. Always references a valid user and content target; soft-delete for auditability and recovery. No user or content data is denormalized.

Key relationships:
- References user who liked, and target post or comment (application logic enforces only one is non-null per row).
- Timestamped and soft-deletable for abuse control and audit history.
- Used to aggregate like counts at query time.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: User giving the like reaction. {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post if the like is for a post (mutually exclusive with comment_id). {@link politico_eco_bbs_posts.id}

foreignFields.name: comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment if the like is for a comment {@link politico_eco_bbs_comments.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when the like was cast (created).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp of this like event (null if active).

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_dislikes
models.description:
Records of 'dislike'/'downvote' reactions from users on posts or comments. Mirrors the like table structure, each record links a user and a post or comment, uniquely per user-content pair. Supports auditability, duplicate prevention, and timestamping. Intended for negative feedback logic and aggregation for content moderation policies.

Key relationships:
- Points to the user (actor), and either a post or comment (never both).
- Enforces (user_id, post_id) and (user_id, comment_id) uniqueness for duplicate prevention.
- Never denormalizes content or user fields; all integrity via foreign keys only.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: User giving the dislike reaction. {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post for the dislike (nullable if it's on a comment). {@link politico_eco_bbs_posts.id}

foreignFields.name: comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment for the dislike (nullable if for post). {@link politico_eco_bbs_comments.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when the dislike was made (created).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for this dislike. Null if not deleted.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_reports
models.description: Stores every abuse report action for content (posts or comments) or user, recording reporting user, target, type/reason, status, actor chain, and associated timestamps. Central to the moderation event lifecycle, enabling time-based review, escalation, and outcome tracking. Related to {@link politico_eco_bbs_report_status_logs} for status/audit, {@link politico_eco_bbs_blinds} for enforcement, and references user/content tables via FKs for context integrity.

foreignFields.name: reporting_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reporting user's {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}. Who submitted the report.

foreignFields.name: target_post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link politico_eco_bbs_posts.id} if report is about a post. Nullable for non-post reports.

foreignFields.name: target_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment's {@link politico_eco_bbs_comments.id} if report is about a comment. Nullable for non-comment reports.

foreignFields.name: target_user_id
foreignFields.description: Target user's {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id} if the report concerns a user (i.e., harassment, impersonation). Nullable where not applicable.

plainFields.name: reported_reason
plainFields.description: The reason/type selected by reporting user (e.g. spam, abuse, misinformation, etc).

plainFields.name: detail
plainFields.description: Freeform description or evidence by reporter. May contain URLs, specific context.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the report (open, reviewed, blind_applied, warning_issued, escalation, closed, etc). Used to determine moderation workflow state.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: UTC datetime when report was submitted.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: UTC datetime when the report entity was last updated by system/process/action.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if the report was voided or retracted. Null otherwise.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_report_status_logs
models.description: Tracks every status or significant field change for a given abuse report, maintaining an audit trail for all moderation actions (assign, review, blind, warn, escalate, close, etc). Enables precise procedural accountability, rollback investigation, and process improvement analytics. Each log record references a specific report via FK and optionally records the moderator/admin actor responsible.

foreignFields.name: report_id
foreignFields.description: Target report's {@link politico_eco_bbs_reports.id}. The abuse report under status update/audit.

foreignFields.name: actor_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator's {@link politico_eco_bbs_moderators.id} if a moderator performed the action. Nullable if action taken by automation/admin.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin's {@link politico_eco_bbs_admins.id} if an admin performed the action. Nullable if not applicable.

plainFields.name: from_status
plainFields.description: Status value before the action (e.g. open, reviewed, blind_applied, etc).

plainFields.name: to_status
plainFields.description: Status value after the action. Captures the moderation workflow transition.

plainFields.name: action_verb
plainFields.description: The action taken (assign, review, blind, warn, escalate, close, etc) as granularity for audit.

plainFields.name: action_detail
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation, notes, or reason for the action. Often used for audit justification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: UTC datetime when this log/event was recorded.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_blinds
models.description: Represents application of blind (hide) status on reported or policy-violating content. Connects to reports, target content/user, and issuing moderator/admin. Records scope, rationale, and enforced timespan. Critical for transparency and restoring trust in policy enforcement decisions.

foreignFields.name: report_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to generating abuse report's {@link politico_eco_bbs_reports.id} that justified the blind action. Nullable for policy/manual blinds.

foreignFields.name: target_post_id
foreignFields.description: Blind applied post's {@link politico_eco_bbs_posts.id}. Nullable for user/comment-wide blinds.

foreignFields.name: target_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Blind applied comment's {@link politico_eco_bbs_comments.id}. Nullable for post/user-wide blinds.

foreignFields.name: target_user_id
foreignFields.description: Blind applied user's {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id} (user restriction). Nullable for content-only blinds.

foreignFields.name: actor_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Issuing moderator's {@link politico_eco_bbs_moderators.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Issuing admin's {@link politico_eco_bbs_admins.id}. Nullable if not issued by admin.

plainFields.name: scope
plainFields.description: Scope of blind (e.g. post, comment, user, all_content). Indicates what was hidden by policy enforcement.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Explanation or policy type for why the blind was enforced.

plainFields.name: start_time
plainFields.description: Timestamp when blind took effect.

plainFields.name: end_time
plainFields.description: Timestamp when blind was lifted/expired. Nullable if still in effect.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the blind record was written.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the blind record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if the blind was reversed/deleted. Null otherwise.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_warnings
models.description: Tracks all punitive warnings delivered to users following moderation review/escalation chained to reports. Records which report, what content/user is being warned/who issued warning, and explanatory message/justification. Crucial for progressive moderation history and enforcing repeated offense policy.

foreignFields.name: report_id
foreignFields.description: Origin report's {@link politico_eco_bbs_reports.id} spawning the warning. May be null for manual warnings.

foreignFields.name: target_user_id
foreignFields.description: Target warned user's {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Issuing moderator's {@link politico_eco_bbs_moderators.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Issuing admin's {@link politico_eco_bbs_admins.id}. Nullable if not issued by admin.

plainFields.name: warn_reason
plainFields.description: Explanation provided to user on why this warning applies.

plainFields.name: context
plainFields.description: Further details on what specific behavior or content was in violation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Issue timestamp of the warning.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_escalations
models.description: Stores escalation events—when moderation or admin review and intervention are required above standard report workflow (e.g. for urgent policy/abuse/legal cases). Connects to the original report, target, escalation initiator and reviewer/decider, rationale/timeline, and outcome notes. Central for compliance and governance reporting.

foreignFields.name: report_id
foreignFields.description: Underlying report's {@link politico_eco_bbs_reports.id} at source of escalation.

foreignFields.name: initiator_user_id
foreignFields.description: Escalation initiator's {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id} (mod or admin who flagged escalation).

foreignFields.name: reviewer_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reviewer or ultimate authority admin's {@link politico_eco_bbs_admins.id} for final escalation disposition.

plainFields.name: escalation_reason
plainFields.description: Why escalation was required (e.g. urgent risk, legal, repeated abuse, pattern match).

plainFields.name: rationale_detail
plainFields.description: Supporting detail for compliance or legal trace.

plainFields.name: outcome_status
plainFields.description: Final outcome of escalation (approved, denied, further_action, etc).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timezone-aware timestamp when escalation was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the escalation record was last updated.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_auth_logs
models.description: Authentication event logs for politico-eco-bbs. Captures successful and failed login, logout, token, and session actions for all member roles (user, moderator, admin). Used for security audit trails, fraud investigation, incident response, and compliance review. May reference the user, moderator, or admin who triggered the event and related metadata including IP, user agent, result code, grant/deny reason, and session context.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the acting user's {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}, if role is user.

foreignFields.name: moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the acting moderator's {@link politico_eco_bbs_moderators.id}, if role is moderator.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the acting admin's {@link politico_eco_bbs_admins.id}, if role is admin.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type of authentication event (e.g., login, logout, token_issued, token_revoked, password_reset_attempt, etc.).

plainFields.name: identifier
plainFields.description: User identifier used for authentication (e.g., username, email, external id).

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address from which the authentication event was initiated.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: HTTP user agent string at the time of event.

plainFields.name: result_code
plainFields.description: System/HTTP result code after event attempt (e.g., success, fail, locked, throttled, etc.).

plainFields.name: result_message
plainFields.description: Summary or detail of auth result; error message if failed.

plainFields.name: session_id
plainFields.description: Session or token id associated with the authentication event, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the authentication event occurred.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_access_logs
models.description: Access logs covering resource access or actions by all users, moderators, and admins within politico-eco-bbs. Captures full audit trail for every critical page/API/feature access. Used for forensic analysis, monitoring, abuse/incident review, security audits, and policy compliance traceability. References actor details and targeted resource.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the acting user's {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}, if role is user.

foreignFields.name: moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the acting moderator's {@link politico_eco_bbs_moderators.id}, if role is moderator.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the acting admin's {@link politico_eco_bbs_admins.id}, if role is admin.

plainFields.name: resource_type
plainFields.description: Type of resource accessed (e.g., post, comment, policy_page, settings, admin_panel, API, etc.).

plainFields.name: resource_id
plainFields.description: Primary key, UUID, or composite string ID of resource accessed; can be null for general access logs.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Business-aware action performed on the resource (e.g., view, edit, update, delete, blind, warn, escalate, export, etc.).

plainFields.name: target_ip
plainFields.description: Originating IP address involved in the access or action.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: HTTP user agent of the actor for this access event.

plainFields.name: outcome_code
plainFields.description: Access result or HTTP/system outcome (success, forbidden, error, throttled, blocked, etc.).

plainFields.name: outcome_message
plainFields.description: Detail of access result or error, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when access or resource action occurred.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_policy_change_logs
models.description: Logs for policy, configuration, and permission changes within politico-eco-bbs. Captures all admin or moderator events that affect roles, policy documents, system/board configuration, permissions, category/rule/setting changes, filter definitions, or escalation triggers. Used for compliance trace, rollback planning, audit and responsibility assignment for any security or regulatory decision.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to admin responsible for the policy change. {@link politico_eco_bbs_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to moderator triggering the policy change (rare). {@link politico_eco_bbs_moderators.id}.

plainFields.name: change_type
plainFields.description: Type/category of the policy or config change (e.g., permission_update, escalation_rule, legal_policy, system_setting, category_edit, etc.).

plainFields.name: object_type
plainFields.description: What entity/type was affected (setting, category, filter, permission, etc.).

plainFields.name: object_id
plainFields.description: Object/setting/category/rule ID affected; may be null for top-level policy changes.

plainFields.name: before_value
plainFields.description: Value/info before the change (JSON/BLOB if complex); used for rollback/audit comparison.

plainFields.name: after_value
plainFields.description: Value/info after the change (JSON/BLOB if complex); used for audit and diff review.

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: Human or system-provided reason/rationale for the change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the policy/config change event.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_error_logs
models.description: Logs of detected or non-recovered application errors within politico-eco-bbs, such as backend exception, failed workflow, audit alert, lost resource, or blocked operation. Used for root cause analysis, error resolution, debugging, incident response, and audit compliance. Provides developer- and admin-ready event context, containing stack trace, attached object/ref, actor, and traceable metadata.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to user who encountered the error (if known). {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to admin associated with the error event (if present). {@link politico_eco_bbs_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to moderator associated with the error event (if present). {@link politico_eco_bbs_moderators.id}.

plainFields.name: error_type
plainFields.description: Classifier for error event (e.g., backend_exception, validation_failed, timeout, not_found, permission_denied, etc.).

plainFields.name: severity
plainFields.description: Severity code (e.g., info, warning, error, fatal).

plainFields.name: reference_id
plainFields.description: ID of the subject/resource most closely associated with the error event, if any.

plainFields.name: method
plainFields.description: Method or API endpoint where the error occurred.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent involved, if relevant.

plainFields.name: stack_trace
plainFields.description: Error/exception stack trace, if captured.

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Error message or summary suitable for user/ops/diagnostics/audit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the error was recorded.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_kpi_snapshots
models.description: Regular periodic snapshots of platform-wide KPIs for politico-eco-bbs, such as DAU, MAU, growth, engagement, report rates, and retention statistics. This table aggregates critical business metrics at fixed intervals for reporting, analysis, and anomaly detection. Used for historical KPI trend analysis, quarterly/annual reviews, and dashboard reporting. No direct FK to users or content; covers macro-level, system-wide statistics only.

plainFields.name: kpi_period_start
plainFields.description: Start of the KPI aggregation period (typically midnight).

plainFields.name: kpi_period_end
plainFields.description: End of the KPI aggregation period (exclusive bound).

plainFields.name: dau_count
plainFields.description: Daily Active Users for the period.

plainFields.name: mau_count
plainFields.description: Monthly Active Users for the period.

plainFields.name: new_user_count
plainFields.description: Number of new user signups in the period.

plainFields.name: retention_1d_rate
plainFields.description: 1-day retention rate for the period (as a fraction, not percent).

plainFields.name: retention_7d_rate
plainFields.description: 7-day retention rate for the period (as a fraction).

plainFields.name: retention_30d_rate
plainFields.description: 30-day retention rate for the period (as a fraction).

plainFields.name: avg_post_per_user
plainFields.description: Average number of posts per user during the aggregation period.

plainFields.name: avg_comment_per_user
plainFields.description: Average number of comments per user during the aggregation period.

plainFields.name: report_count
plainFields.description: Total report events counted in the period.

plainFields.name: blind_count
plainFields.description: Total moderation blinds (content hidden or moderated) in the period.

plainFields.name: churn_user_count
plainFields.description: Number of users considered churned (no longer active) in the period.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update (aggregation/correction).

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_user_activity_metrics
models.description: Aggregated periodic user activity metrics for reporting, analytics, and behavioral analysis. Tracks key activity data for each user, such as number of posts, comments, logins, likes, dislikes, average session time, first activity, and more during a given period. Used to identify active/inactive users, engagement level, power users, and retention analysis. References the base user table for relationships but not user PII.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Target user's {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}.

plainFields.name: metric_period_start
plainFields.description: Start of the activity aggregation period.

plainFields.name: metric_period_end
plainFields.description: End of the aggregation period (exclusive bound).

plainFields.name: post_count
plainFields.description: Number of posts created by the user during the period.

plainFields.name: comment_count
plainFields.description: Number of comments made by the user during the period.

plainFields.name: login_count
plainFields.description: Number of successful logins by the user during the aggregation period.

plainFields.name: like_count
plainFields.description: Number of likes submitted by the user during the aggregation period.

plainFields.name: dislike_count
plainFields.description: Number of dislikes submitted by the user during the aggregation period.

plainFields.name: avg_session_seconds
plainFields.description: Average session time in seconds the user spent on the platform in the period.

plainFields.name: first_activity_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of the user's first measurable activity in this period.

plainFields.name: last_activity_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of the user's last activity in this period.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of metric row creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to metric row.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp (row is inactive if non-null).

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_content_traffic_metrics
models.description: Aggregates and snapshots content (post/comment/category) level traffic metrics (views, likes, dislikes, engagement, etc) for a reporting window. Used for traffic analytics, content performance dashboards, reporting of most/least engaged content, and trend monitoring. Allows multi-dimensional queries by time, content type, and category. FKs to posts, comments, and categories as appropriate; null when not applicable (e.g., view/interaction at category level).

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link politico_eco_bbs_posts.id}, if this metric is for a post. Nullable when metric is for comment or category.

foreignFields.name: comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment's {@link politico_eco_bbs_comments.id}, if this metric relates to a comment. Nullable otherwise.

foreignFields.name: category_id
foreignFields.description: Target category's {@link politico_eco_bbs_categories.id}, if content metric is at category level. Nullable if not relevant.

plainFields.name: metric_period_start
plainFields.description: Start of aggregation period for these metrics.

plainFields.name: metric_period_end
plainFields.description: End of aggregation period (exclusive bound).

plainFields.name: view_count
plainFields.description: Total number of views for the content during the period.

plainFields.name: unique_visitor_count
plainFields.description: Count of unique visitors viewing the content in the period.

plainFields.name: like_count
plainFields.description: Total likes the content received during the period.

plainFields.name: dislike_count
plainFields.description: Total dislikes received for the period.

plainFields.name: comment_count
plainFields.description: Total comments received by this content within the period (posts or categories).

plainFields.name: report_count
plainFields.description: Number of reports submitted against this content in period.

plainFields.name: blind_count
plainFields.description: Number of times the content was blinded (moderated) during the period.

plainFields.name: engagement_rate
plainFields.description: Engagement rate (interactions per view) for the period.

plainFields.name: bounce_rate
plainFields.description: Rate of single-view exits (user did not engage) for the period.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Metric creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Metric last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp (marks row as inactive if set).

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_retention_metrics
models.description: Cohort and retention analytics snapshots for politico-eco-bbs. Stores aggregates and rates by cohort (e.g. signup week/month), period, and metric dimension. Enables analysis of user retention, cohort growth, churn, and long-term engagement. Rows are immutable snapshots for interval reporting and historical trend analysis.

plainFields.name: retention_period_start
plainFields.description: Start date/time of the analytic retention window (e.g., a day, week, or month).

plainFields.name: retention_period_end
plainFields.description: End date/time of the retention window (exclusive bound).

plainFields.name: cohort_type
plainFields.description: Name/type of the cohort grouping (e.g., 'signup_week', 'signup_month', 'campaign').

plainFields.name: cohort_id
plainFields.description: Value identifier for the cohort (e.g., week number '2024-W31', month '2024-08', or campaign name).

plainFields.name: cohort_size
plainFields.description: Total users in the cohort at the start of the window.

plainFields.name: retained_count_1d
plainFields.description: Number of cohort users retained at 1-day mark in period.

plainFields.name: retained_count_7d
plainFields.description: Number of cohort users retained at 7-day mark.

plainFields.name: retained_count_30d
plainFields.description: Number of cohort users retained at 30-day mark.

plainFields.name: churn_count
plainFields.description: Number of users lost/churned from the cohort in the period.

plainFields.name: retention_rate_1d
plainFields.description: 1-day retention rate for this cohort snapshot.

plainFields.name: retention_rate_7d
plainFields.description: 7-day retention rate for this cohort.

plainFields.name: retention_rate_30d
plainFields.description: 30-day retention rate for this cohort.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for retention metric snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this metric row.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_risk_events
models.description: Root table storing each recorded risk/compliance incident (e.g., policy violation, data breach attempt, regulatory event, security issue, or any incident requiring formal compliance review). Each entry represents a unique occurrence under the scope of legal/audit review. Linked by foreign keys to user/admin tables for originators, responsible parties, and context actors (from already-existing user tables). Serves as the audit root for other compliance models (audits, evidence, escalations). Fully normalized, retaining historical/amendment fields and traceable change chain for regulatory inspection.

foreignFields.name: creator_user_id
foreignFields.description: Originator of the risk event. {@link politico_eco_bbs_users.id}

foreignFields.name: assigned_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin or compliance officer assigned to review or resolve the event. {@link politico_eco_bbs_admins.id}

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Event type (e.g., 'policy_violation', 'system_abuse', 'security_incident', 'legal_notice'). Enumerated at application layer. Enables categorization for compliance reporting.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Lifecycle status of the risk event (e.g., 'open', 'under_review', 'resolved', 'closed', 'escalated'). String (enum-limited at app layer), used for workflow control and audit.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the risk/incident, context, or observed abnormality—used for compliance investigation and regulatory reviews.

plainFields.name: regulatory_reference
plainFields.description: Relevant law, standard, compliance reference, or policy article ID (e.g., 'PIPA-28', 'GDPR-33', 'service_policy-3.2', etc). Enables downstream mapping to compliance frameworks. Nullable if non-regulatory.

plainFields.name: detected_at
plainFields.description: Original datetime the risk event or abnormality was detected. For audit chains and incident forensics.

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the event was marked resolved by compliance/admin action. Stays null until fully actioned and closed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp (immutable).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (set on each change).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp (null if active, set if archived/deleted for retention/audit only).

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_compliance_audits
models.description: Formal compliance audit or internal/external review record tied to a specific risk event, supporting governance and regulatory traceability. Each record represents a completed audit step, stating findings, reviewer, result, and any prescriptive advice. Enables fine-grained tracking of all assessments, requirements, or external audits for risk events (including regulatory, security, and legal reviews). Credentials all actions for future evidence, precedent, or recurring issue analysis.

foreignFields.name: risk_event_id
foreignFields.description: The risk event under review. {@link politico_eco_bbs_risk_events.id}

foreignFields.name: reviewer_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin or compliance officer conducting the audit. {@link politico_eco_bbs_admins.id}

plainFields.name: audit_type
plainFields.description: Type of audit or review conducted (e.g., 'regulatory', 'security', 'internal', 'external', 'recurring_review'). Used for compliance mapping and reporting.

plainFields.name: findings
plainFields.description: Findings or outcome of the audit/review (text summary of issues, compliance gaps, or passes). Used for compliance management, improvement, and reporting.

plainFields.name: recommendations
plainFields.description: Recommended actions or next steps based on audit outcome (prescriptive, can be empty string if no advice).

plainFields.name: regulation_reference
plainFields.description: Regulatory article, law, or compliance framework referenced by the audit (GDPR, PIPA, ISO27001, etc). Optional if review was not governed by a standard.

plainFields.name: audited_at
plainFields.description: Date and time at which the audit/review was formally completed. Used for traceability and evidence chain.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp (immutable).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (set on each change).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp. Null if active; set for audit chain retention.

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_evidence_files
models.description: Evidence or supporting files (immutable attachments) for risk events and/or compliance audits. Allows traceable chain-of-custody of screenshots, logs, scanned documents, or forensic files required for legal/compliance proofs. Each record is immutable, stores source file metadata and structural link to either a risk event or a compliance audit. File storage URI is strictly separated from attachment flows for routine user-content. Important for regulatory examination, litigation, or dispute forensics.

foreignFields.name: risk_event_id
foreignFields.description: Linked risk event if evidence is attached to a risk/compliance incident. {@link politico_eco_bbs_risk_events.id}

foreignFields.name: compliance_audit_id
foreignFields.description: Linked audit if evidence is tied directly to an audit step (not mandatory). {@link politico_eco_bbs_compliance_audits.id}

foreignFields.name: uploader_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin uploading/providing the evidence file to the compliance chain. {@link politico_eco_bbs_admins.id}

plainFields.name: file_uri
plainFields.description: Secure URI of evidence or proof file. Not reused with user content attachment system; for compliance-only files.

plainFields.name: mime_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the uploaded file (e.g., 'application/pdf', 'image/png'). Compliance chain requires this for examination and chain-of-custody validations.

plainFields.name: file_size_bytes
plainFields.description: File size in bytes (integer, for audit/evidence storage management, cap enforcement).

plainFields.name: file_description
plainFields.description: Free-text description of evidence contents/purpose (e.g., 'network log before incident', 'email screenshot', 'regulatory notice scan', etc). Used in compliance reviews.

plainFields.name: uploaded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded or registered to the record (immutable). For compliance/audit control.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-deletion timestamp (null if active; set for chain-of-custody audits and retention compliance).

models.name: politico_eco_bbs_legal_escalations
models.description: Formal table recording all legal or regulatory escalations arising from risk events (e.g., court, police, regulator, or external compliance authority involvement). Tracks the escalation chain, status, responsible admin, referenced compliance or legal codes, involved parties, and resolution outcomes. Used for long-term compliance proof, legal defense, and regulatory audit. Each record strictly references a risk event and (optionally) a compliance audit, and documents lifecycle for full chain-of-custody, evidence, and external notification requirements.

foreignFields.name: risk_event_id
foreignFields.description: Risk event which triggered the escalation process. {@link politico_eco_bbs_risk_events.id}

foreignFields.name: audit_reference_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the compliance audit directly leading to this escalation. {@link politico_eco_bbs_compliance_audits.id}

foreignFields.name: initiator_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin responsible for formal escalation (typically DPO or senior compliance/legal). {@link politico_eco_bbs_admins.id}

plainFields.name: escalation_type
plainFields.description: Class of legal escalation (e.g., 'court_filing', 'police_report', 'regulator_notification', 'third_party_complaint', etc). Allows reporting and policy mapping.

plainFields.name: external_authority
plainFields.description: Short name/title of the external authority or body notified in the escalation (e.g., 'Seoul Eastern District Court', 'KISA', 'NPA', etc). Used for regulatory chain.

plainFields.name: case_reference
plainFields.description: Official case or docket number assigned by the external authority/court. Optional if not yet issued.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status of the escalation process (e.g., 'pending', 'in_review', 'resolved', 'dismissed', 'no_action', etc). String for workflow tracking and compliance documentation.

plainFields.name: outcome
plainFields.description: Describes the final, intermediate, or current result of the escalation (e.g., 'regulator warning issued', 'case dismissed', 'court ruling: in favor', 'pending reply', etc). Essential for full compliance evidence.

plainFields.name: initiated_at
plainFields.description: When the escalation process was originally initiated/submitted. Used for legal/audit time-chaining.

plainFields.name: finalized_at
plainFields.description: Date/time escalation was definitively closed, receives outcome, dismissed, or otherwise finalized (null if ongoing). For chain-of-custody, legal proof.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp (immutable).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (set on each change).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-deletion timestamp. Null if active; set for legal chain retention.

 * Represents foundational global system settings for the entire

 * other domains, such as service mode, policy toggles, registration

 * classification throughout the system. Categories may include system
 * reserved or special types, and may be referenced by system settings or
 * post tables. This table enables centralized management of the community's
 * categorical structure.
 * 
 * @namespace Systematic

### `politico_eco_bbs_system_settings`

Represents foundational global system settings for the entire
politico-eco-bbs platform. Contains configuration fields that impact all
other domains, such as service mode, policy toggles, registration
control, and global flags for features or audits. No user or
content-specific data is stored here. This table is referenced by all
modules for runtime configuration, supporting centralized business rule
management and rapid platform-wide changes.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `service_mode`
  > Current service mode (e.g. 'production', 'staging', 'maintenance').
  > Determines operational status and feature gating for the system.
- `registration_enabled`
  > Whether new user registration is currently enabled or blocked at the
  > system level. Used for emergency closure, compliance holds, or scheduled
  > maintenance.
- `content_filter_global_enabled`
  > Global toggle controlling whether content filtering rules (from
  > politico_eco_bbs_filters) are active on all user-generated content.
  > Central switch for compliance or crisis mode.
- `default_category_id`
  > Default category for new posts. Reference to
  > politico_eco_bbs_categories.id, used when no explicit category is
  > selected.
- `attachment_global_enabled`
  > Whether any file attachments are globally enabled across the system. Used
  > for risk control, migration, or compliance events.
- `audit_log_enabled`
  > Controls whether all system-level actions and changes are recorded to the
  > audit log for compliance and forensics.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the settings entry.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of the last modification to the settings entry.
- `deleted_at`: Time the settings entry was deleted (soft delete, nullable).

### `politico_eco_bbs_categories`

Maintains the list of allowed categories for posts (e.g. 'politics',
'economy', etc.), defining the hierarchical taxonomy used for content
classification throughout the system. Categories may include system
reserved or special types, and may be referenced by system settings or
post tables. This table enables centralized management of the community's
categorical structure.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `parent_category_id`
  > Optional parent category's [politico_eco_bbs_categories.id](#politico_eco_bbs_categories).
  > Enables category tree/hierarchy.
- `code`
  > Unique business code for the category (e.g. 'POL', 'ECO'). Used for
  > internal references and integrations.
- `name`
  > Human-readable display name for the category (multi-language aware in
  > business logic if needed).
- `description`: Optional description of the category for moderators or UI tooltips.
- `sequence`
  > Ordering position for display/UI, indicating where the category appears
  > in ordered lists.
- `is_active`
  > Whether this category is currently enabled for post assignment and user
  > selection.
- `created_at`: When the category record was created.
- `updated_at`: When the category was last modified.
- `deleted_at`: Time the category was deleted (soft delete, nullable).

### `politico_eco_bbs_filters`

Defines global and rule-based content filtering policies, such as block
keywords, prohibited link domains, and moderation flag patterns. These
rules are applied across all user-generated content when filtering is
enabled. Supports audit, compliance, and community policy enforcement
with fine-grained rule support.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `filter_type`
  > Type/category of filter (e.g. 'keyword', 'domain', 'regex'). Enables
  > extensible policy application.
- `value`
  > The filter value (e.g. prohibited keyword, blocked domain, or regex
  > pattern) enforced by the system.
- `active`: Whether this filter rule is currently active and enforced by the system.
- `description`
  > Optional business context for the filter rule (e.g. who requested,
  > compliance note, applicability hints).
- `created_at`: Filter rule creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Filter rule last updated timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Time the filter rule was deleted (soft delete, nullable).

### `politico_eco_bbs_attachment_settings`

Controls global and content-type-specific rules for allowed file
attachments across the platform. Includes maximum size, permitted MIME
types, and risk/virus scanning enablement. Used by core upload,
moderation, and system components to enforce attachment policy and
security constraints. No individual file data, only configuration rules.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `max_attachment_size_mb`
  > Maximum file upload size in MB allowed for any single attachment.
  > Enforced system-wide.
- `allowed_mime_types`
  > Comma-separated list of MIME types permitted for upload (e.g.
  > 'image/png,image/jpeg,application/pdf').
- `virus_scan_enabled`
  > Whether uploaded files are subject to automated virus or malware scanning
  > prior to acceptance.
- `attachment_note`
  > Business or compliance note about why these settings are in effect (e.g.
  > recent policy change, risk advisory).
- `created_at`: When the attachment settings record was created.
- `updated_at`: Most recent update to the attachment settings entry.
- `deleted_at`: Time the attachment settings were deleted (soft delete, nullable).

### `politico_eco_bbs_guests`

Temporarily tracked session and identity data for
unauthenticated/anonymous users (guests). Provides support for session
token allocation, guest device/IP tracking, and basic auditing during
guest interaction with the platform (read-only access, pre-registration
flows). No persistent profile information is stored; relates to
authentication and access logs for session events. Enables compliance
with real-time restriction, abuse detection, and guest policy
requirements.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `session_key`
  > Opaque random session key or identifier allocated to a guest session for
  > stateful tracking. Used for correlating guest interactions across
  > requests in a privacy-compliant fashion.
- `last_seen_ip`
  > IP address of the guest's most recent access. Used for abuse detection,
  > throttling, and basic compliance. IPv4 or IPv6 format.
- `last_seen_device`
  > User agent/device information (truncated string) last observed for the
  > guest. Supports device fingerprinting and rate limiting.
- `jwt_payload`
  > Raw JWT payload string issued to the guest (if token-based sessions for
  > guests are allowed). Session restoration depends on this value. Null if
  > not used for this guest session.
- `created_at`: Timestamp of guest session creation.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of last update to this guest session record.
- `deleted_at`: Timestamp when record was soft-deleted, if applicable.

### `politico_eco_bbs_users`

Registered member profile records for fully authenticated users, holding
email credentials, password hashes, verification state, and core access
permissions. Represents all general users who have completed sign-up via
verified email, supporting account state, join/leave tracking, login
history, and advanced session control. Connected to access/audit logs,
escalation, and policy records for compliance and role transition
traceability.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`
  > Unique email address for user authentication and identity. Acts as the
  > user's principal credential.
- `password_hash`
  > Secure hash of the user's password, stored for login verification. Never
  > exposed as raw credentials. Supports salt+hash with strong KDF (e.g.,
  > bcrypt with at least 10k rounds).
- `email_verified`
  > Indicates whether user email has successfully completed verification.
  > Ensures user joins the platform with confirmed identity.
- `role_status`
  > Logical user role state: 'user', 'pending', 'locked', or other
  > application-defined value reflecting current account status for access
  > and privilege control. Used for status gating, not for role escalation
  > (see moderators/admins).
- `last_login_at`
  > Timestamp of the user's last successful login event. For security
  > monitoring and anomaly detection.
- `last_login_ip`
  > IP address from which last login occurred. Used for compliance and
  > identity verification.
- `permissions`
  > Comma-separated or JSON-encoded permission keys granted to this user.
  > Used to determine the user's scope of action in the system.
- `created_at`: User account creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update time for this user record.
- `deleted_at`: When account was soft-deleted or deactivated (logical delete), if ever.

### `politico_eco_bbs_moderators`

Moderator roles assigned to elevated users responsible for community
governance, content moderation, and escalation. Tracks moderator
promotion/demotion, custom scope, role initiator, and temporal fields.
Provides connection to the corresponding user entity (user id) and links
to trace role assignment history. All moderator-specific
access/permissions are referenced here, not in user table. Role-change
events reference audit and escalation logs for full traceability.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `user_id`
  > Referenced user account's [politico_eco_bbs_users.id](#politico_eco_bbs_users). Identifies
  > user entity elevated to moderator status.
- `promotion_reason`
  > Free-form text or policy code describing why promotion to moderator was
  > enacted. Supports audit and compliance explanations.
- `promoted_by_admin_id`
  > References the account ID (from admins) that performed this moderator
  > assignment. May enable 1:N if multiple admins can assign moderators, else
  > optional.
- `moderator_scopes`
  > JSON or comma list of board/category codes specifying the scope (areas)
  > the moderator can operate on. Limits access by domain. Used for
  > fine-grained role isolation.
- `demotion_at`
  > Timestamp of demotion (or null if active). Allows historic tracking of
  > role status transitions.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when moderator record was created.
- `updated_at`: Last update to this moderator record (role changes, scope changes, etc).
- `deleted_at`: Soft-delete (logical deletion) of this moderator role record.

### `politico_eco_bbs_admins`

Highest-level platform administrator roles. Each record links to a user
that has been escalated to admin authority (direct system/policy/resource
control). Tracks details of escalation (promotion origin), privileges
(policy override, emergency grant), and historical status. Role
assignment/demotion and temporary escalation events are traceable through
this table, referencing user identities and admin action audit logs. Not
directly linked to general user status (which remains in users table).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `user_id`
  > Associated user account's [politico_eco_bbs_users.id](#politico_eco_bbs_users), representing
  > this admin identity. Strict 1:1 correspondence between user accounts and
  > admins.
- `promotion_reason`
  > Text or code specifying why the user was promoted to admin. Maintains
  > policy compliance and escalation rationale.
- `promoted_by_admin_id`
  > Admin user (self or other) who executed the promotion. Used for
  > cross-reference or audit chain building.
- `demotion_at`: When this admin status was revoked (null if currently active).
- `emergency_escalation`
  > Flag indicating whether this admin promotion resulted from an emergency
  > override/escalation (bypassing normal workflow). Tracks special
  > escalation cases.
- `policy_override_scope`
  > Comma-separated codes or JSON for areas/resources where this admin is
  > permitted to override default policies. Enables flexible, granular
  > authority modelling.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp for the admin privilege record.
- `updated_at`: Update timestamp for this admin role assignment record.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft-delete or logical removal timestamp for this admin role assignment
  > record.

### `politico_eco_bbs_posts`

Main entity for user-created discussion posts in the politico-eco-bbs
service. Each record represents a user-generated thread with title, body,
category, author, status, and moderation lifecycles. Supports referencing
categories, creators (users), moderation actors, and rich content
attachments (via attachment table). Historical edits, workflow changes,
or moderation events are logged separately. All post data adheres to 3NF,
with no pre-calculated aggregates or denormalized user information.

Key relationships:
- Category: Each post references a category (e.g., politics, economics).
- Author: Created by a registered user (politico_eco_bbs_users).
- Status/Workflow: Moderation and deletion handled by separate
admin/moderator tables.
- Attachments: Linked via politico_eco_bbs_attachments.
- Comments: Comments stored separately for scalability.
- Supports unique (per-channel) title/indexes to enhance anti-duplication
and search optimizations.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `category_id`
  > Reference to the category of the post. {@link
  > politico_eco_bbs_categories.id}
- `author_id`
  > Reference to the user who created the post. {@link
  > politico_eco_bbs_users.id}
- `last_editor_id`
  > Reference to the user who last edited the post (nullable, for posts never
  > edited). [politico_eco_bbs_users.id](#politico_eco_bbs_users)
- `title`
  > Title of the post. Required, 1 to 100 characters, must pass prohibited
  > word check.
- `body`
  > Main content of the post, up to 10,000 characters. Rich text/Markdown
  > permitted, must pass all filters.
- `is_blind`
  > Whether the post is currently blinded (hidden from regular users by
  > moderation action).
- `is_locked`: Whether the post is locked (further comments or edits prevented).
- `comment_count`
  > Current number of visible comments associated with this post (for query
  > optimization, not persisted, can be recalculated).
- `created_at`: Timestamp when post was created. Set once upon creation.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of the last update. Updated only when post is modified.
- `deleted_at`: Soft-delete timestamp (null if active).

### `politico_eco_bbs_post_drafts`

Stores draft states for posts being composed by users. Each draft is
linked to its owner, allows limited number of concurrent drafts per user,
and may reference an existing post for edit operations. Drafts are not
visible to other users until published. Soft-delete and timestamped for
audit.

Key relationships:
- Owner: Each draft is owned by a user (politico_eco_bbs_users).
- Target Post: Optionally references the post being edited, otherwise
null for new drafts.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `owner_id`: User who owns the draft. [politico_eco_bbs_users.id](#politico_eco_bbs_users)
- `target_post_id`
  > If editing an existing post, references the original post. {@link
  > politico_eco_bbs_posts.id}
- `title`: Draft post title. May be null when user has not entered a title yet.
- `body`: Draft post content. May be null in incomplete stage.
- `created_at`: Draft creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of last modification to the draft.
- `deleted_at`: Draft soft-delete timestamp.

### `politico_eco_bbs_comments`

Represents comments, and optionally replies, on posts. Each comment
references its parent post and the author, and may have a parent comment
(for reply/quote structure). Soft-deletion, blinding, and workflow status
fields are included. Follows strict normalization: no user, post, or
category data denormalized. All relations via foreign keys only;
historical versions kept via snapshot model if introduced in future.

Key relationships:
- Post: Each comment is attached to a post.
- Author: Registered user.
- Parent: Optionally references another comment for threading
(single-level nesting by business policy).

Moderation:
- Blind flag for moderatorial hiding.
- Deletion via deleted_at; all changes timestamped for audit.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `post_id`: Parent post this comment belongs to. [politico_eco_bbs_posts.id](#politico_eco_bbs_posts)
- `author_id`: User who wrote the comment. [politico_eco_bbs_users.id](#politico_eco_bbs_users)
- `parent_comment_id`
  > Direct parent comment (for replies). Null for top-level comments. {@link
  > politico_eco_bbs_comments.id}
- `last_editor_id`
  > User who last edited this comment. Null if never edited. {@link
  > politico_eco_bbs_users.id}
- `body`: Text/body of the comment. Required, 1–500 characters, filter enforced.
- `is_blind`: Whether this comment is currently hidden/blinded by a moderator.
- `created_at`: Time this comment was created.
- `updated_at`: Time of most recent change.
- `deleted_at`: Soft-delete timestamp (null if active).

### `politico_eco_bbs_comment_drafts`

Draft storage for comment creation or edit workflows. Each draft is
associated with an owner (user) and a target post and/or comment. Used in
client multi-step authoring or in in-progress edits; never visible to
public until submitted. Implements audit fields for tracking saves,
updates, soft-deletion. Each user may possess only a limited number of
drafts per post by business policy.

Key relationships:
- Owner: Registered user.
- Post: Required parent post being commented on.
- Target comment: Optional, for replies or edits.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `owner_id`: User who owns the draft. [politico_eco_bbs_users.id](#politico_eco_bbs_users)
- `post_id`: The post being commented under. [politico_eco_bbs_posts.id](#politico_eco_bbs_posts)
- `target_comment_id`
  > If editing/replying, references the original comment. {@link
  > politico_eco_bbs_comments.id}
- `body`: The draft comment content. May be null until first save.
- `created_at`: Draft creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Time this draft was last changed.
- `deleted_at`: Soft-delete timestamp of draft (null if active).

### `politico_eco_bbs_attachments`

Attachment records for files (e.g., images, documents) assigned to a post
or comment. Each record maintains metadata for security, moderation, and
reference. Stores URI and references settings which define allowed
extensions, sizes, and holds soft-deletion and blinding flags for
moderation.

Key relationships:
- Attached to either a post or comment, one or both foreign fields
enforced at application logic.
- References specific attachment settings for file type and policy
enforcement.
- Creator: User who attached the file.
- Blinding: Marks attachments as visually hidden/pending review.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `post_id`
  > If attached to a post, references the target post. {@link
  > politico_eco_bbs_posts.id}
- `comment_id`
  > If attached to a comment, references the target comment. {@link
  > politico_eco_bbs_comments.id}
- `creator_id`: User who uploaded this attachment. [politico_eco_bbs_users.id](#politico_eco_bbs_users)
- `attachment_setting_id`
  > Attachment settings reference for allowed extensions, size, etc. {@link
  > politico_eco_bbs_attachment_settings.id}
- `uri`
  > Permanent URI for retrieving the file resource. String must match policy
  > and point to protected storage.
- `name`: Original (user-uploaded) filename, extension enforced by settings.
- `size`: File size in bytes, limited by attachment settings policy.
- `is_blind`: Flag if this attachment is currently hidden by moderation action.
- `created_at`: Attachment creation timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Attachment soft-delete timestamp (null if active).

### `politico_eco_bbs_likes`

Records of 'like' reactions from users on posts or comments. Each record
links a user, target (post or comment), and is unique per user-content
pair. Used for upvote/positive feedback features, prevents duplicate
reactions via composite unique constraint. Always references a valid user
and content target; soft-delete for auditability and recovery. No user or
content data is denormalized.

Key relationships:
- References user who liked, and target post or comment (application
logic enforces only one is non-null per row).
- Timestamped and soft-deletable for abuse control and audit history.
- Used to aggregate like counts at query time.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `user_id`: User giving the like reaction. [politico_eco_bbs_users.id](#politico_eco_bbs_users)
- `post_id`
  > Target post if the like is for a post (mutually exclusive with
  > comment_id). [politico_eco_bbs_posts.id](#politico_eco_bbs_posts)
- `comment_id`
  > Target comment if the like is for a comment {@link
  > politico_eco_bbs_comments.id}
- `created_at`: Time when the like was cast (created).
- `deleted_at`: Soft-delete timestamp of this like event (null if active).

### `politico_eco_bbs_dislikes`

Records of 'dislike'/'downvote' reactions from users on posts or
comments. Mirrors the like table structure, each record links a user and
a post or comment, uniquely per user-content pair. Supports auditability,
duplicate prevention, and timestamping. Intended for negative feedback
logic and aggregation for content moderation policies.

Key relationships:
- Points to the user (actor), and either a post or comment (never both).
- Enforces (user_id, post_id) and (user_id, comment_id) uniqueness for
duplicate prevention.
- Never denormalizes content or user fields; all integrity via foreign
keys only.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `user_id`: User giving the dislike reaction. [politico_eco_bbs_users.id](#politico_eco_bbs_users)
- `post_id`
  > Target post for the dislike (nullable if it's on a comment). {@link
  > politico_eco_bbs_posts.id}
- `comment_id`
  > Target comment for the dislike (nullable if for post). {@link
  > politico_eco_bbs_comments.id}
- `created_at`: Time when the dislike was made (created).
- `deleted_at`: Soft-delete timestamp for this dislike. Null if not deleted.
